title: Loop template
description: One loop type of the catalogue (flow, level, temperature, ...). A template carries the generic engineering defaults a loop inherits from its type: expected dynamics, KPI limits, diagnosis rules, tuning rule and target, allowed tests and a safe default step. Templates are data, fully editable by the site; no plant-specific values belong here.

key.description: Stable identifier used by the loop's type field.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the console.

description.description: What the loop type is for and what an engineer must watch.

process_kind.description: Process kind assumed by the identification and tuning rules.

dynamics.description: Expected range of the identified process dynamics (a FOPDT model for self-regulating loops; gain is the velocity gain in output units per PV unit per second for integrating loops).

time_constant_s_min.description: Shortest expected dominant time constant, seconds.

time_constant_s_max.description: Longest expected dominant time constant, seconds.

kpi_thresholds.description: Limits the monitoring KPIs are compared with; shares are fractions from 0 to 1.

service_factor_min.description: Minimum share of time in the intended mode (auto, cascade).

saturation_share_max.description: Maximum share of time at an output limit.

oscillation_index_max.description: Maximum ACF oscillation index before the loop is flagged.

noise_ratio_max.description: Maximum PV noise ratio (noise standard deviation over signal standard deviation).

diagnosis_rules.description: Cause classes checked for this loop type, in the fixed diagnosis order of PRODUCT 4.1.

tuning.description: Preferred tuning rule and closed-loop target for this loop type.

rule.description: Tuning rule the assistant proposes first.

target_closed_loop_time_constant_ratio.description: Closed-loop time constant divided by the dead time; 1 is fast and tight, 4 is robust and slow.

robustness.description: Default position of the speed/robustness slider, 0 fast to 1 robust.

tests.description: Tests the assistant may propose for this loop type.

default_step_pct.description: Safe default OUT step as a percentage of the output span.
